newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean foreign reserves up slightly in September.
newsitem.headline: Chilean foreign reserves up slightly in September.

text.p: Chilean foreign reserves rose $89 million last month to $15.267 billion, the Central Bank reported.
Foreign reserves stood at $14.8 billion in September 1995, it said.

The rise last month was due to a $272 million surplus in the balance of payments, minus a $183 million reduction in the value of liquid assets due to exchange rate variations, said the bank in its bimonthly macroeconomic report.
